ranges.review: One of my favorites. Steel targets for pistols, a .22 steel target range, and a great skeet range. They're a little strict about rapid firing. Last time I went I was skeet shooting. I've heard you now have to shoot rifles sitting down, which is lame, so I'm going back to check it out.
